Release is a deliberate change by Raf on or after the go-live date: set this to true and push. The date below is recorded for reference only; it is NOT checked in the browser or at build time.
_notes.previewOverride: A private preview build may force the flag with PREVIEW=1 ISLAMIC_GIVING_RELEASED=true node scripts/build.mjs. The override is ignored unless PREVIEW=1 is also set.

allocation.heading: Your donation. Real help. Clear proof.
allocation.intro: Your donation funds practical essentials and the work needed to get them to people who need them. Here is how we plan to allocate a standard Drop donation.
allocation.dropText: Funds the practical essentials and delivery costs set out in each Drop's budget.
allocation.canonical15: 15% supports the work needed to get your help where it is intended and show you what was delivered. This includes fundraising and general operating costs.
allocation.sharedPurpose: Two parts of one purpose: getting practical help to people who need it.
allocation.specialistNote: Specialist giving routes have separate policies.
allocation.supportingNote: Planned standard allocation. Specialist giving routes have separate policies.
